findings.finding: The $10.9m senior secured convertible note (issued 2025-12-08, matures 2026-12-08) converts at the holder's election, at a price that resets and carries anti-dilution adjustment. Its forbearance expired 2026-06-30 with no extension as of the 10-Q, so the holder faces no contractual barrier to converting and selling on any session, the window included. The conversion is large against a 1.51m-share float.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Not a dated event. It is a standing right the holder can exercise on any session, including 10-12, with no forbearance in force. A falling price lowers a reset conversion price and raises the number of shares on conversion. No conversion has been reported: shares outstanding are unchanged at 1,509,118 and no 13G has been filed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No conversion has been disclosed, so this name has no reaction history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang has been public since 08-14, so most of it is priced. What the price may not hold is the reset: after a 35% two-day fall the conversion share count is larger than it was on 10-07. If the holder were selling, the volume would be elevated; today's 0.86x does not show heavy supply, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The 2026-05-04 8-K Exhibit 10.3 (Forbearance Agreement with Alto Opportunity Master Fund) is the same counterparty and the same instrument, so it is not independent. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1894525/000121390026051125/ea028839301ex10-3.htm

outside_window.finding: MindChain mainnet was guided for 'October 2026' in the 07-28 release, subject to legal, regulatory and technical conditions. No day was given and it has not launched as of 10-09. A go-live release would be a positive catalyst for a name that spiked +42.6% on its last deal release, but the date is unknown.

NYSE American non-compliance notice of 2026-04-17 (Section 1007, late filing), with a cure period expiring 2026-10-15 that can be extended by up to six months. The 10-K and both 10-Qs have since been filed, so a compliance-regained notice is the likelier outcome.

The convertible note matures 2026-12-08 and $5m of notes matured 2026-07-01 with no extension disclosed as of 08-14. Going-concern language is in the 10-Q, with cash of $278k against $117m of digital assets (BTC, NILA, USDT). Refinancing or selling assets is the path.

Conversion of the Series A preferred into 14,954,040 common (about 10x the common float) is the trigger in the 2026-09-10 settlement amendment for the post-interim board and for releasing $8m of restricted cash. It is undated.
